edges.reason: rawFulfillRandomness reads msg.sender to authorize the caller

External entry point dispatches into the fulfillment callback path that mutates randomResult
fulfillRandomness is the callback body reachable from the external coordinator call
requestRandomness performs the external LINK.transferAndCall before updating nonces
The VRF coordinator can re-enter rawFulfillRandomness while the request is still in flight
External transferAndCall can trigger the coordinator callback that lands in fulfillRandomness
getRandomNumber calls requestRandomness with keyHash and fee
getRandomNumber is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier
getRandomNumber is guarded by the onlyOneTime modifier
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against the stored owner
onlyOwner reads the owner state variable
onlyOneTime reads the times counter to gate execution
getRandomNumber increments times by 1 to lock further requests
getRandomNumber passes keyHash into requestRandomness
getRandomNumber passes fee into requestRandomness
The LINK immutable token address is the call target of transferAndCall
nonces[_keyHash] is incremented with SafeMath add inside requestRandomness
requestRandomness sends the fee to the vrfCoordinator address
requestRandomness consumes the _keyHash parameter for seed and nonce lookup
requestRandomness consumes the _fee parameter as the transfer amount
vRFSeed is derived from keyHash, placeholder seed, contract address and nonce
fulfillRandomness consumes the requestId parameter
fulfillRandomness consumes the randomness parameter
randomness modulo and +1 write into randomResult
NUMBER_OF_PARTICIPANTS bounds the modulo arithmetic that produces randomResult

oldOwner is read from the owner state variable before reassignment

normalization_plan.reason: The requestId parameter is only consumed by fulfillRandomness and carries no independent behaviour
The randomness parameter flows directly into the randomResult arithmetic in fulfillRandomness
The _keyHash parameter is used exclusively inside requestRandomness for seed and nonce computation
The _fee parameter is the value forwarded to the external LINK.transferAndCall operation
vRFSeed is a transient local produced and consumed entirely within requestRandomness
oldOwner is a transient local used only for the OwnershipTransferred event in acceptOwnership
